item.summary: fix(diffs): stop lightweight CLI registration from crashing when runtime.state is unavailable (#128360) * fix(diffs): stop lightweight CLI registration from crashing The diffs plugin has no cli-metadata.ts, so the lightweight CLI metadata loader fell back to plugin.ts and called register() with an empty runtime, crashing on api.runtime.state.openBlobStore for any non-bundled install (e.g. the published @openclaw/diffs npm package). Add a no-op cli-metadata.ts, matching every other bundled plugin's convention, so CLI metadata capture stops there instead of loading the full runtime. Fixes #128330 * fix(diffs): skip runtime setup while collecting CLI metadata --------- Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger
